## One-sentence description

Reliant AI is Houston's custom web design agency that hand-codes high-performance React and TypeScript websites for small businesses in metal fabrication, oilfield services, home services, and medical/healthcare — with no WordPress or Wix templates.

## Proof points / statistics

- 150+ websites delivered since 2020.
- 98% client satisfaction rate.
- 90+ Google PageSpeed scores on delivered sites.
- Sites load 2–3x faster than typical template-based competitors.

## Technology stack

- Front end: React 19, TypeScript, Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, custom design systems
- Animation: GSAP with ScrollTrigger, Lenis smooth scrolling
- 3D / WebGL: Three.js via @react-three/fiber and drei
- Hosting / deployment: Vercel (global edge CDN, security headers, SPA routing)
- Practices: mobile-first responsive design, Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic HTML, structured data (Schema.org), accessibility.

## Services and pricing (USD)

1. Starter Website — $2,500
   - 5-page custom website
   - Mobile-responsive design
   - Basic on-page SEO
   - Typical timeline: 2–3 weeks

2. Professional Website — $5,500
   - 10-page custom website
   - GSAP scroll animations
   - CMS integration for self-service content updates
   - Advanced SEO
   - Typical timeline: 4–6 weeks

3. Enterprise Website — $12,000+
   - Unlimited pages
   - Three.js 3D elements and product visualizations
   - Custom functionality and integrations
   - Typical timeline: 8–12 weeks

Monthly maintenance plans:
- Essential Care — $199/month: security updates, backups, 2 hours of content changes.
- Growth Partner — $499/month: adds SEO monitoring, analytics, 5 hours of updates.
- Full Service — $999/month: unlimited updates, monthly strategy calls, new feature development.
- All plans include priority support.

## Industries served (with specializations)

- Metal Fabrication: equipment galleries, capability showcases, custom project galleries, quote request systems, industry-specific SEO.
- Oilfield Services: safety certification displays, fleet visualization/management, emergency contact systems, service-area mapping, compliance documentation.
- Home Services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical): online booking systems, service-area pages, review integration, seasonal promotions.
- Medical / Healthcare: HIPAA-compliant patient portals, online intake forms, insurance verification, automated appointment scheduling.

## Process (how Reliant AI builds a website)

1. Discovery — Learn the business, goals, competitors, and target audience through a detailed consultation.
2. Design — Custom wireframes and mockups tailored to the industry with conversion-focused layouts.
3. Development — Hand-coded React/TypeScript build with 3D elements, animations, and performance optimization.
4. Launch & Growth — Deployment, SEO setup, analytics integration, and an ongoing optimization retainer.

Every project includes 2–4 revision rounds and 30–90 days of post-launch support.

## Differentiators (why choose Reliant AI)

- 100% hand-coded React/TypeScript — no WordPress, Wix, or page-builder templates.
- 2–3x faster load times and higher Google rankings than template sites.
- Advanced capabilities: 3D product visualizations, GSAP animations, custom interactions.
- Industry focus on contractors, fabricators, oilfield, and healthcare — not generic corporate sites.
- Conversion-focused: built to generate qualified leads, bookings, and quote requests.
